scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem is supported by a self-contained proof, including exact residual equivalence and Fibonacci counting. Finite checks are corroborative, not infinite certificates. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for successor-dyadic shifts; general shifts remain open. Known finite values in OEIS are not claimed novel; unindexed equivalent sources remain possible.
title: Exact state complexity of successor-dyadic Thue–Morse shifts
